about.description: IEFA is an ETF perpetual listed on Gate, tracking iShares Core MSCI EAFE ETF, margined and cash-settled in USDT. Traders get synthetic price exposure only — no ownership, dividend or voting rights in the underlying. Funding settles every 8h. Up to 20× leverage. Margin is custodied by the exchange rather than self custodied, and access requires exchange onboarding with identity verification.
